title: oven-roasted flambe norwegian bananas grill
description: a tangy, crumbly, and nostalgic norwegian dish featuring bananas, flambe, and a gluten-free-friendly vessel, the raclette-grill. perfect for a weeknight dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: flambe mixture
ingredients.notes: see below for flambe mixture ingredients

instructions: preheat the raclette-grill to 375 f (190 c) for at least 15 minutes before cooking.
in a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
slice the bananas into 1-inch pieces and place them in a separate bowl.
melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
add the flambe mixture to the saucepan and ignite it (carefully!)
once the flames have died down, carefully pour the flambe mixture over the bananas and then sprinkle the sugar mixture evenly over the top.
transfer the bananas to the preheated raclette-grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the bananas are caramelized and the sugar is crispy.
serve immediately, garnished with additional cinnamon if desired.
